end.summary:
Counted sides and corners of triangles, rectangles, stars, and circles.
Named shapes from their sides and corners, including when turned.
Correctly stated that a triangle has 3 sides and 3 corners in any position.
Sometimes lost track of the starting point and counted one side twice; this was not confirmed corrected by the end.
Teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Asha practised counting sides and corners by tracing around each shape and identifying shapes in different positions. Ayaan explained clearly that turning a triangle does not change its 3 sides and 3 corners, and they identified a rectangle and circle using their features. At the end, they still needed support to keep track of the starting point and avoid counting one line twice. At home, have them mark the starting corner with a dot, trace each side once, and say the total aloud.
